I Transformed the World Spawn in Hardcore Minecraft!

In this episode of my Hardcore Minecraft series, I flatten and clear the spawn to a blank canvas, then build the broken beacon ruin and terraform the surrounding land to sell hundreds of years of age and decay. This is part 2 of the original lore from episode 1.

This series was heavily inspired by Luke TheNotable, WadZee, aCookieGod, Forge Labs, and Sandiction.
